prompt: Create a vertical futuristic fashion poster with an archival print-glitch aesthetic. A young woman with long straight black hair poses on and beside a white sport motorcycle, centered slightly right, full body visible. She wears a pale pink helmet with visor raised, a white strapless top, white high-waisted shorts, pale pink/white oversized protective pants or moto chaps, and white pointed boots; one leg is lifted and bent over the motorcycle seat while one hand rests on the handlebar and the other holds a white motorcycle helmet with black geometric vents. Keep the motorcycle large in the lower half, angled from lower left toward right, with visible handlebars, fairing, rear wheel, and small cyan decal accents. Render the image as if it were an old damaged archive print invaded by graphic artifacts: beige-gray paper texture, vertical fold lines, dust, stains, scratched ink, faded contrast, halftone dot blocks, misregistered black and pink ink, photocopy noise, and scattered ASCII-like code fragments. Add a thick irregular off-white cutout-sticker outline around the woman and motorcycle silhouette, with the outline broken by pixels, halftone dots, and corrupted printed symbols. Background typography should include exactly 4 oversized distressed letters: a large black "X" in the upper left with a pink misprint smear, a large black "A" on the left middle, a large gray "Z" on the right middle behind the subject, and a large gray "R" near the lower left. Scatter many tiny code marks and numbers such as 001, 010, +, x, /, ::, and 01001 across the page, but keep them decorative and partially illegible. Use a muted palette of dusty beige paper, black ink, faded white, pale blush pink, and small cyan accents. The mood should feel like a future fashion motorcycle poster found inside an old archive folder: gritty, high-fashion, analog print failure, cyberpunk collage, not clean digital UI. No extra people, no readable logos beyond small abstract decals, no cropping of the main subject, no modern glossy magazine layout.
